emptyRoom: No briefing data. Generate this file with forma room.
thesis: {blocked} things need you out of {open} open across {programs} programmes.
thesisOne: {blocked} things need you out of {open} open across one programme.
thesisQuietOne: Nothing is open in this programme.
thesisQuietLede: {closed} issues have been closed and none are outstanding. Every panel below is showing you that, not failing to load.
provPortfolioOne: Counted across one programme · re-derived by forma check
provMovingOne: Open work not matching the blocking rule, in one programme
provBlockedOne: {n} issue matches a blocking rule this programme declared · never inferred
chartNoIssues: No issues in the snapshot, so there is nothing to plot.
chartNoOpen: Every issue is closed, so there is no open work to plot.
noBlocked: Nothing is waiting on you in this snapshot.
closedOpenChart: Closed and open work across the portfolio
planCoverageNote: {accounted} of {requirements}: {withIssues} on issues, {verifiedOnly} by a named verification.
historyMissing: This snapshot predates issue dates, so history cannot be derived from it. Re-run forma verify.
techBuckets: Every issue, by what is known about it
kanbanCount: Issues: {n} · partition re-derived by forma check
queueCount: Open issues: {n} · order re-derived by forma check
queueComplete: No open issues remain in the derived queue.
techHonesty: What this briefing does not know
rulesComplete: Every programme declares its blocking rule.
ruleUnknown: Blocking rule not declared. Its issues are counted as neither blocked nor moving.
allMilestoned: Every open issue has a milestone.
behind: Architecture source is {n} commits behind HEAD.
behindOne: Architecture source is {n} commit behind HEAD.
noDrift: No architecture map, so commit drift is unavailable.
sweepsNone: No commit exceeded the file threshold.
sweepsCount: {n} commits touched more files than the threshold. They are counted here and attributed to no node.
mapMissing: Architecture map missing. No model and topology were supplied for this programme.
timelineMissing: This programme declares no architecture timeline, so there is nothing beyond the current state.
wbsConstant: columns that never vary are not shown
wbsMissing: This programme declares no requirements matrix. Add an rtm block to its manifest entry to derive one.
wbsHoles: What the matrix does not cover
wbsComplete: The matrix has no holes: every requirement lands on work, and every open issue is claimed.
docsNone: This programme declares no documents. Add docs.include to its manifest entry.
docsBudget: {n} documents embedded, within the byte budget.
optHowToChange: Change what is here by editing {file} and running forma room again. forma scan rewrites the programme list from a directory of checkouts without discarding what you turned off.
techLede: Everything below is either audited with evidence, or named as not audited.
provCounted: Counted over {n} issues in the {date} snapshot · re-derived by forma check
provDerived: Derived by roomderive · re-derived by forma check on every run
provPortfolio: Counted across {n} programmes · re-derived by forma check
provBlocked: {n} issues match a blocking rule this programme declared · never inferred
provMoving: Open work not matching the blocking rule, across {n} programmes
provAudit: Written by the audit channel · every row carries evidence that resolves, or it is refused
provHistory: Reconstructed from {n} dated issues in one snapshot · no stored history
provGit: Read from git author dates · issues only, pull requests excluded
provLink: Issue → commit citing it → files touched → C4 node · git only, no LLM
provRtm: Read from the documents this programme declares · gated by forma check
provCheckpoints: Closure of the issues that landed on the nodes each checkpoint patches
provHonesty: What the briefing cannot see, counted and named rather than dropped
provOptions: Read from {file} · the only file this page can change
provExcluded: Declared in the manifest and deliberately left out
provDocsReader: Carried in full from the programme's own repository, git-tracked only
provDocsNone: No documents are declared for this programme
landingSingle: {n} issue(s) last landed in {month}; one month is not a series
wbsSplit: {withIssues} land on issues; {verifiedOnly} name a verification instead. A requirement doing neither, and open work no requirement claims, both fail the gate.
ruleInert: Blocking rule declared with no labels, so it can never match. Its issues are counted as moving.
provBuckets: {closed} closed, and {open} open issues partitioned by what is known about them
bucketClosedNote: not part of the partition below
noBlockedHere: No issue in this programme matches its blocking rule.
mismatchLede: Where the facts disagree with each other, or with what a programme declared.
kpiLinkedNote: share of all issues a commit tied to a C4 node; the rest stays unknown, never zero
